_doc: First-person presentation (ADR-0029). Read by the arms generator (tools/assetgen/blender/lib/char_fp.py bakes one fp_* action per hold pose, attack and use) and by ViewModel at runtime. Positions and directions are in camera space (x right, y up, z back; metres). A hand spec places the hand by its grip: 'grip' point, 'dir' (handle axis, thumb side), 'knuckles' (where the knuckles point), 'fist' / 'thumb' curl 0..1 (fist 1 closes round a ~3.5 cm handle, up to 1.3 a bare fist), 'index' extra index curl (-1 points), 'elbow' hint added to the rest elbow direction; or {'on': 'R', 'along': m, 'spin': deg} grips the other hand's handle. Attack and use keys are [frame, channels, ease] with channels relative to the hold: S.move [x,y,z] m, S.rot [pitch, yaw, roll] deg about the camera axes (pivot on the grip), S.elbow, S.along, S.spin and the curls. Edit, then `python tools/build_assets.py --match fp_arms` and import.

wrist._doc: A wrist's range (degrees, ADR-0045): flexion, extension, radial and ulnar deviation (an ellipse between them) and the forearm's roll either way of the thumb-up rest. PoseSolver keeps every baked hand inside it (the elbow swings to line the forearm up first, then the hand turns back about its grip); test_viewmodel_holds checks the baked arms.

defaults._doc: Hold class of an item without equip.hold: by equip.kind, then (melee) by damage_type, then by category. use_by_category picks the use action for consumables.

empty._doc: Bare hands: loose fists at the lower edge, ready.

one_hand._doc: Axes, hatchet, machete, knife, hammer: low right, the head angled in, the off hand loose at the left edge with the tether on its wrist.

club._doc: Stone club, steel pipe: both hands on the handle, cocked up over the right shoulder.

spear._doc: Spear: low at the right hip, point forward to the centre. The shaft lies diagonally across the rear palm (item rot: 60 degrees about the palm's normal, an oblique grip), so the wrist can hold it forward; the front hand under the shaft follows the shaft, not the socket (ADR-0045).

two_hand._doc: Shovel: carried ready to dig, the rear fist overhand on the butt at the right hip and the shaft running down and forward past the centre, blade low in front; the front hand under the shaft. The shaft lies across the rear palm (item rot: 60 degrees about the palm's normal, an oblique grip as the spear's), so the blade can point down without the wrist bending past its range (TD-172).

light_left._doc: Torch, flashlight, lighter: held up in the left hand, the right hand loose and ready.

flashlight._doc: Flashlight: overhand in the left fist, the lens out of the little-finger side so the beam goes where you look; the forearm crosses the lower left. The right hand loose and ready.

pistol._doc: Revolver: low ready in the right hand, barrel forward.

held._doc: Anything small carried on the right palm: resources, medicine, placeables, stones.

food._doc: A can, a bar, a mushroom: in the right fist, ready to eat.

bottle._doc: A bottle upright in the right fist.

blueprint._doc: Laying out a blueprint: the Field Manual open on the left palm, the right hand pointing.

carry_log._doc: A log on the right shoulder: its front end rises out of the top right; the right hand steadies it from below, the left hangs free.

lighter._doc: Lighter: upright in the left hand at chest height, fingers round its body, the thumb over the wheel and the flame up and a little forward; the right hand down out of view.

attacks._doc: fp_<name>: played over the item's attack_time, so `impact` (the hit resolves at attack_time x impact) sits on the keyed contact frame.

tether._doc: Raising the left wrist to read the tether (T): the reading pose, how long the raise and lower take, the viewmodel's narrower field of view while reading (the screen fills more of the view), and the screen's glow lowered / raised.

guard._doc: Holding Block with a melee weapon raises the hold's guard: a blow from within arc_deg of where you face loses the hold's (or equip.block's) share of its damage, costing stamina per blocked hit plus per point absorbed. You can't attack while guarding.

motion._doc: Procedural motion on top of the baked poses. breathe: period s, pos m, rot deg. sway: the rig lags the view (deg of lag per rad/s of turn), sprung. move: lag against velocity changes. bob: per footstep (pos m, rot deg), scaled when sprinting / crouched. sprint: the lowered pose (pos m, rot deg) blended in while sprinting. land: dip per m/s of landing speed. equip: seconds to raise a new item.

impact._doc: Feedback when a swing connects, by what it hit: hitstop (s the swing freezes), camera kick (pitch, yaw, roll deg; sprung back), rig recoil (m), and particles where the target makes none of its own.

stagger._doc: Taking a hit knocks the arms: deg and m per point of damage, capped; a blocked hit jolts the guard instead.

_doc_off_hand: Holds that use one hand drop the other below the view (it comes up to guard or read the tether): the owner's playtest found an open hand floating palm-down in the lower corner distracting.
